description: I’m a Software Engineering student from Bangladesh interested in web development, AI/ML, data, and problem-solving. For NASA Space Apps, I want to build “Field Shift,” using NASA data to explore how environmental changes affect agriculture. I know C/C++, JavaScript, Node.js, React, Git, and basic backend development. Looking for teammates interested in AI/ML, data analysis, UI/UX, maps, agriculture, or storytelling.
